blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Multi-sectoral groups have joined forces to intensify a campaign supporting more than 250 farming families in Sariaya, Quezon, who have been stripped of their rights to lands awarded to them under the government’s agrarian reform program. The “Save Sariaya Now!” campaign was launched at the Diocese of Lucena’s Sentro Pastoral in Lucena City on Friday, Oct. 16, coinciding with the observance of World Food Day. The campaign aims to defend agrarian reform, protect farmers, and advance food sovereignty. The event brought together representatives of farmers’ and fishers’ organizations, civil society groups, the academe, religious institutions, and government officials. […]...
